name: Motorized Bicycle
description: Louisiana's moped category: a pedal bicycle propelled by human power, a helper motor or both, with a motor rated no more than 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W), an automatic transmission and a top design speed of 25 mph on a flat surface. A pedal e-bike over an electric-assisted bicycle's limits but within these lands here.

restrictions.rule: A pedal bicycle propelled by human power, a helper motor or both, with an automatic transmission
Its motor is rated no more than 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W), and the definition also caps an engine at 50 cc
A maximum design speed of no more than 25 mph on a flat surface
Not a motor vehicle or a motorcycle under Louisiana law
Riders must be 15 or older and hold a valid Louisiana driver's license
Riders must wear a motorcycle safety helmet secured with a chin strap
Titled and registered with the Office of Motor Vehicles; one that doesn't meet the definition, such as a pocket bike, can't be registered as one
Ridden only on the roadway: never on sidewalks or interstate highways
